newsitem.title: USA: Signature proposes $200 mln notes offer.
newsitem.headline: Signature proposes $200 mln notes offer.

text.p: Signature Resorts Inc on Thursday said it has proposed an offering of $200 million of Senior Subordinated Notes, due 2007.

Signature said it intends to use the proceeds from the offering to retire existing indebtedness, to finance customer mortgages receivable of vacation intervals and to complete construction and expansion at certain of its resorts.

The company will also use the proceeds to finance the acquisition and development of additional resorts and vacation ownership related assets and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
